q: Codex is going to do the actual typing on this task. Do I put Codex down as the owner?
needle: put models like Codex and Claude in `executed_by`

q: My builder hit its usage cap halfway through the job. Should I throw the partial work away and mark it failed?
needle: leave the worktree intact with a note

q: This is a two-line change but I'd like a judge and a long-running goal around it so it's tracked properly. Good idea?
needle: Never size up a quick fix into a campaign

q: We're about to close out a long-horizon goal. What housekeeping pass should run first, and how old does a task have to be before it gets cleared?
needle: to clear stale tasks (>3 days)

q: Someone typed a plain English request instead of a command name. Which part of the code figures out what they meant?
needle: maps natural phrases to CLI commands

q: When the test runner is going, where does state that normally lives in the home dot-folder end up?
needle: redirects `~/.atris` state to a throwaway folder under `node --test`

q: How often does the automatic landing pass fire, and what is the scheduled job called?
needle: hourly labeled cron (`ATRIS_AUTOLAND_<project>`)

q: After the wiki upkeep pass refreshes pages, does it send them up to the cloud on its own?
needle: does not auto-push; the local wiki stays the source of truth

q: How often does the CLI actually hit the npm registry to see if a newer release exists?
needle: 1-hour cache for registry checks

q: Where did the method behind our security audit command originally come from, and under what license?
needle: Method adapted from cloudflare/security-audit-skill (MIT)

q: The log of engine start and end readings keeps growing. Is there any size limit, and what survives when it trims?
needle: past 4 MB it keeps the newest 2 MB

q: My receipt says everything passed on my machine. Is that enough to say master is healthy?
needle: local pass and CI pass are different claims

q: We shipped a big new self-healing feature. Shouldn't that get a huge jump in the version number?
needle: Bumping 3.5.0 → 4.20.0 for a feature release

q: I'm about to email a customer an HTML summary. What stops the send outright?
needle: HTML email has no render proof.

q: I see two similar endpoints and want to pull out a shared helper now. When is that worth it?
needle: three concrete examples before you abstract

q: My page copy points out what the reader's team is missing. How should I reframe it?
needle: Show what we are good at instead of what they lack.

q: I'd like a huge stat on the page with a tiny caption underneath. Is that okay?
needle: unless the number means something on its own

q: Someone asked me to add to the project wiki. Should that go to the business workspace online or stay in the repo?
needle: Cloud is opt-in. Use `--cloud` only when

q: Can I set the recurring heartbeat to fire every five minutes so it moves faster?
needle: Never schedule a cron that fires more than once per 10 min.

q: This command failed twice the same way. Should I just run it once more?
needle: Never retry the same failing action a third time.

q: Could an agent quietly switch to an easier check after doing the work but before the final run?
needle: An agent cannot swap rubrics mid-tick.

q: The audit noticed we skip a recommended practice but there's no real exploit. Is that reported as a finding?
needle: A missing best practice is a hardening note, not a finding.

q: Why did we create a dedicated member just for how messages read to the operator?
needle: said "this told me nothing"
